evaluation: nested model selection plus four expanding-window forward tests
model_selection: Seven prespecified logistic candidates are ranked only on the final two years of each training era; the outer test window never tunes the model.
leakage_controls: each outer test window occurs strictly after all fitting and inner selection data
candidate selection uses only the final two years inside the training era
only current-visit environment, season and region are used
current algae counts and future environmental values are excluded
gaps longer than 14 days are excluded rather than labelled negative
boundary: Retrospective next-observed-sample ranking benchmark; not a continuous 14-day forecast, farm warning, causal model or regulatory threshold.
